hypotheses.mechanism: Perpetual longs pay positive funding to a hedged spot-long/perp-short. A 75% initial cash reserve reduces short-side collateral risk versus the earlier 50% reserve.
hypotheses.rule: Buy spot and sell equal base quantity at 2024-01-01 daily open, hold fixed hedge quantity to cutoff open. Target spot notional 25% of 5000 USDT, remainder USDT collateral. No transfers from spot gains to futures, no borrowing, rebalancing, compounding of funding or invented liquidation fills. If observed margin bound fails, report mechanical unliquidated cashflows separately and executable result unknown.

hypotheses.mechanism: Funding can persist, but frequent entry consumes it. Enter only when 28 days of strictly lagged realized funding would cover a conservative round trip with a 50% buffer.
hypotheses.rule: At fixed nonoverlapping 28-day anchors from 2024-01-01, sum funding rates from anchor-29d inclusive to anchor-1d exclusive. Require complete 8-hour baseline buckets, accept additional valid settlements but never impute. Enter only if signed sum exceeds 0.0135 (1.5 times 90 bps). Hold exactly 28 days, or to the fixed final cutoff; always close before next decision. Target 25% of then available account equity spot, remainder collateral; equal quantity short. Gate never changes with cost scenarios. Missing lagged rates/price/liquidity means no entry with reason. Missing held outcomes means unknown portfolio; never renormalize.

hypotheses.mechanism: Slow diffusion of flows can prolong medium-term price moves; long only positive trends, diversify over liquid symbols, and keep unused weights in USDT.
hypotheses.rule: Each Monday 2024-01-01 through 2026-08-31 use the preserved historical archive catalog and same 90 complete positive delayed daily bars/median 30d quote volume >=5m USDT as v5. Data end Saturday close. Among at least ten eligible symbols, rank raw 30-day log spot return descending; require positive 30-day and 7-day raw returns. Select at most five, symbol tie break, 20% equity each, unused cash zero yield. Monday open to Sunday close, full weekly close/reopen even for repeat symbols. No model fitting, grid search, BTC benchmark, or additional parameter variant.

attempt_budget.allowed_reruns: Software corrections only, recorded with cause and old results preserved. No parameter revision after observing performance.

carry_data: Public Binance REST spot daily, perpetual trade-price daily, mark-price hourly and funding settlements. Preserve full response bytes, request URL, actual download known_at, SHA256, normalized hashes. Use perp trade open as execution proxy rather than mark price; mark prices value funding and margin. Exact contiguous bars required; no filling gaps. Funding events at entry hour excluded; exit and later events excluded. Funding rates of either sign retained. No interpolation. Only cutoff candle open may be used; later fields ignored.
carry_liquidity: Before each entry require previous 30 complete delayed daily spot AND perpetual trade candles, median quote volume >=5m USDT. Public current exchangeInfo used for reference common spot/perp quantity step and min notional; round quantity down to a common valid step. These are current constraints, not certified historical filters. Historical account eligibility, step changes, price limits and executable depth remain unknown.
carry_margin: Single isolated cash collateral book, no spot collateral credit. Entry trading costs deducted from cash reserve. At each complete hour calculate conservative lower equity: cash + all funding before hour + negative funding during hour + q*(short entry price - hour mark high). Ignore positive current-hour funding for this bound. Require lower equity > 1% stressed mark notional plus 0.5% close reserve. Report minimum surplus, first breach, and a separate instant +30% mark-jump stress on every hourly high, without assuming matched spot gains can be transferred. These assumed conservative margins are not historical liquidation certification. Report daily portfolio close drawdown plus non-synchronous daily low-spot/high-perp stress bound; distinguish both from actual intraday drawdown.

carry_costs.accounting: Fees and slippage proportional to each reference traded notional, paid in USDT; quantities match exactly. No free fee token or maker rebate assumed. Residual is spread over calendar days once first entered, including later cash periods; no charges if never entered. Compression cuts positive receipts only, preserves every negative payment, adds a one-time execution mismatch loss per entry. Report residual-cost breakeven after trading. Tax, account actual fees, funding delivery, conversion, transfer, custody loss and eligibility unknown, not zero.

spot_costs.factor: Same v5 multiplicative fee/quantity convention and documented exact-horizon identity resolutions, including extra sell legs. Unknowns retained with 20% allocation; measured whole-portfolio result null if any selected outcome unknown. Separately show total-loss and flat-gross-recovery assumptions, never estimates or universal recovery bounds.

decision: First report every outcome regardless of sign. Missing selected outcome or margin-bound breach prevents executable-readiness claim. Positive base alone = conditional historical positive. Positive adverse plus positive descriptive bootstrap lower bound and no observed margin breach = candidate for separately frozen future observation only; otherwise no robust historical candidate under registered checks. Passing is neither independent confirmation nor investor net profit. No external investment comparison or required return amount.
delivery: Version protocol before data collection/evaluation, save separate trial registry, complete ledgers/results, source hashes and reproducible offline runner/tests. Preserve all old evidence and new negative results. Do not add another automation for new rules in this task.
